symptom: Customers report that checkout orders are not completing as expected

report.summary: Incident window shows gateway-mock returning 429 TooManyRequests to payment-service on POST /authorize (D20, D22: 6 rejections vs 5 successes). Payment-service logs the 429 as FAILED (D41), so 6 orders became PAYMENT_FAILED (D10, D12, D50) while 5 others were authorized. Gateway-mock logs no errors and shows healthy latency (D36), and no restarts occurred. The gateway rejects requests it receives, so the root is gateway-mock with DEPENDENCY_REJECTING.
